tagline: Suisei ended the tour in Fukuoka and walked off stage with a Sony deal and a WME contract. Ironmouse is the Best VTuber for the third time and /vt/ is still talking about plasma. Shattered Legends is live. ROF-MAO came back. November is delivering.
inThisIssue: Hoshimachi Suisei announces Sony Music Echoes deal and WME signing at Fukuoka finale — debut single Datte Boku wa December 9; first Asia tour NEVER LANDING coming 2027

lead.title: Hoshimachi Suisei announces Sony Music Echoes deal and WME signing at the Fukuoka finale — debut major-label single Datte Boku wa arrives December 9; Metamorphose domestic tour and first Asia tour NEVER LANDING follow in 2027
lead.body: Hoshimachi Suisei closed the HOSHIMACHI SUISEI ARENA TOUR 2026 Once Upon a Stellar at Marine Messe Fukuoka Hall A on November 12 and used the finale to announce her major-label debut. She has signed with Sony Music's Echoes imprint and with WME for global talent representation. Her debut single under the deal, Datte Boku wa, releases December 9 as a limited two-disc physical set: Disc 1 is the new single, written by Suisei as an answer song to Stellar Stellar; Disc 2 compiles eight catalog tracks including BIBBIDIBA and I don't care. The Fukuoka show was the fourth and final date of the four-city run — K Arena Yokohama in September, GLION Arena Kobe in October, IG Arena Nagoya November 7, and Marine Messe Fukuoka Hall A on November 12 — and was live-viewed at theaters in Japan and overseas via LVE and Event Cinemas. Suisei also announced two 2027 tour legs from the Fukuoka stage: Metamorphose, a domestic tour, and NEVER LANDING, her first Asia tour. No dates have been confirmed for either. She remains a hololive member; Studio STELLAR, her independent management company launched earlier in 2026, produced the arena run and brokered the new deals. The WME signing and an Echoes major-label deal while maintaining a primary agency relationship is not a precedent that existed in this form before this week.

stories.title: Ironmouse wins Best VTuber at the 2026 Streamer Awards — third win in four years; she reclaims the category after TheBurntPeanut's 2025 defense; plasma donation memes trend on X for 36 hours
stories.blurb: Ironmouse took Best VTuber at the 2026 Streamer Awards ceremony in Los Angeles on November 12, her third win in the category after 2023 and 2024, and her first since TheBurntPeanut's 2025 interruption. She used her acceptance remarks to encourage plasma donation for primary immunodeficiency, the condition she has managed publicly throughout her career. The donation call sparked 36 hours of memes alongside a streamer who objected loudly and briefly became a secondary story. TheBurntPeanut released a post-ceremony statement saying it really does not matter; Asmongold, who had been co-streaming and rooting for TheBurntPeanut, moved on. The other nominees — Koseki Bijou, Crelly, and Gigi Murin — were not heard from publicly. The result runs the Best VTuber table at three wins each for Ironmouse (2023, 2024, 2026) and one apiece for the rest.

stories.title: Shattered Legends premieres November 13 — Critical Role and hololive's six-episode Daggerheart actual play is live; Nerissa Ravencroft, Mori Calliope, Shiori Novella, Gigi Murin, and Marisha Ray; Matthew Mercer as GM; airs Fridays through December 18
stories.blurb: Shattered Legends, the six-episode Daggerheart actual play collab between Critical Role and hololive production, premiered November 13 US time on Nerissa Ravencroft's YouTube channel and Beacon.tv. Matthew Mercer serves as GM; the players are Nerissa Ravencroft, Mori Calliope, Shiori Novella, and Gigi Murin from hololive, with Marisha Ray of Critical Role completing the five-player cast. The series is set in Exandria and runs weekly on Fridays at 6 PM PT through December 18. The collab had been announced October 13 with a mid-November premiere window; the November 13 date was confirmed via Critical Role's official schedule. Episode 1 is now live on both Nerissa's YouTube and Beacon.

stories.title: ROF-MAO resumes activities November 15 as a three-member unit — Kagami Hayato, Fuwa Minato, and Kaida Haru return after six months; restart livestream on NIJISANJI YouTube
stories.blurb: ROF-MAO held its restart on November 15, resuming group activities as a three-member unit of Kagami Hayato, Fuwa Minato, and Kaida Haru. The unit has been in a group hiatus since Kenmochi Toya completed his ROF-MAO activities on May 28, 2026. ANYCOLOR confirmed the restart on November 2, alongside a Shibuya ad campaign running November 8-14 — a fan message push called Let's Push ROF-MAO's Back — anchored to the unit's fifth-anniversary visual with the message Because there was a place to return to, and a reason to move forward. The official restart included a livestream on the NIJISANJI YouTube channel. All three returning members had continued individual streaming through the hiatus; November 15 marks the first scheduled group activity since late May.

stories.title: NIJISANJI Okashi na Jikan! launches November 11 — renewal of NIJISANJI no TOYBOX! with Takamiya Rion as pilot MC alongside Nozomi Ishigami and Kuramochi Meruto; airs 20:00 JST
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI's regular variety program renewed as NIJISANJI Okashi na Jikan! on November 11 at 20:00 JST, replacing the long-running NIJISANJI no TOYBOX! format. The pilot episode features Takamiya Rion as MC with Nozomi Ishigami and Kuramochi Meruto as guests. The renewal was announced on October 20. The new title translates roughly to NIJISANJI's Snack Time and maintains the weekly schedule of the TOYBOX series, which ran for multiple years as one of NIJISANJI's flagship variety blocks. The November 11 pilot is the first episode under the new branding.

indies.blurb: Independent VTuber Cassian Aetheria holds their debut stream today, November 16, opening the second half of the November indie calendar. Per hololist.net, the next scheduled independent debut is Leannleo on November 21. The two-week window that opened with the Streamer Awards ceremony, Suisei's Fukuoka finale, and the Shattered Legends premiere creates elevated ambient viewership across the VTuber scene heading into late November — a wider audience discovery window for debuts landing in this stretch than is typical for mid-month slots.

tea.text: The /vt/ Streamer Awards thread opened at approximately 5:29 PM PT on November 12, one minute before the main show, and did not close until 72 hours later. The plasma donation arc hit at the moment of Ironmouse's acceptance remarks, and the thread forked immediately into two parallel channels: one running genuine enthusiasm for the win and genuine donations to the Immune Deficiency Foundation, and one cataloging every downstream meme as it generated. The meme channel is the larger channel. By November 14 it had produced a taxonomy — plasma as currency, plasma as tribute, plasma as ecological resource — and the taxonomy had its own thread. TheBurntPeanut's it really does not matter post arrived on November 13 and was processed in seventeen minutes. The thread concluded he was correct. The thread also concluded this conclusion was insufficient. The result stands: third win for Ironmouse, 2023, 2024, 2026. The plasma memes are still generating. The taxonomy is still taking additions.

The /vt/ Suisei-Sony thread opened at the same time the Fukuoka audience was still applauding. The first post asked whether this means she is graduating from hololive. The second post said no. Posts three through two hundred worked through the question from every available angle. The consensus, reached at post 201 and immediately contested, is that nothing in the announced deal requires her to leave hololive and nothing in the hololive membership structure prevents her from holding it simultaneously, and that therefore no graduation is coming. The counter-argument, introduced at post 202, is that nothing in that logic is load-bearing. The WME signing produced a secondary thread comparing her trajectory to Kizuna Ai, which the main thread flagged as a comparison that generates heat without generating light. The comparison thread agreed and continued anyway. The NEVER LANDING Asia tour dates have not been announced. The thread is monitoring this. The word Metamorphose is now in the board's vocabulary.

The Shattered Legends episode 1 thread had a structure problem: nobody could agree on what it was. It is a Critical Role production, it airs on Nerissa Ravencroft's YouTube, it features four hololive talents and Marisha Ray, and Matthew Mercer is running a system he helped design. The thread attempted to route this into existing categorical infrastructure and produced five competing labels — hololive collab, Critical Role spinoff, actual play, VTuber original content, and something the thread called a tertiary product — none of which resolved. The episode itself was reviewed positively. Gigi Murin's character concept was described as very Gigi, which the thread accepted as analysis. Marisha Ray's presence was described as either an elevation or a complication depending on the poster. Matthew Mercer DMed for one hour and forty-three minutes without being called a bad DM once, which a poster noted is a record for a DM in a collab context.

ROF-MAO's return thread on November 15 hit a specific structural difficulty. There are three chairs in the new frame. The question of the fourth chair arrived at post 11, which is earlier than any previous estimation of when it would arrive. The thread is treating this as a new record. The return livestream was reviewed as good. The unit dynamic was described as intact. The fifth-anniversary visual — powerful back view, black suits, the message about returning and moving forward — was described by several posters as working harder than it should and landing anyway. The question of the fourth chair remains open. Nobody is claiming it is not open. The debate is about how open it should be treated as being and whether that treatment affects anything. Kenmochi Toya has not posted about the return. The thread has logged this as a data point.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 23 November — four days before AFA Singapore and DreamHack Stockholm, the week Shattered Legends episode 2 airs, and somewhere in there Leannleo debuts. Suisei's December 9 single is now the next fixed point on the calendar. See you in seven.
